title: Tetranuclear dysprosium single-molecule magnets: tunable magnetic interactions and magnetization dynamics through modifying coordination number

synthesis.procedure: Complex 1 is the previously reported template and is not prepared in this article. The present work only describes its structure and magnetic comparison with complex 2, obtained by removing two DMF ligands from the Dy1/Dy1a sites of 1.

properties.summary: Both 1 and 2 are Dy4 SMMs. Complex 1 shows a temperature-dependent out-of-phase ac signal under zero dc field but no maximum above 2 K, so the blocking temperature is below 2 K. Room-temperature χMT is close to four uncoupled Dy(III) ions and falls on cooling, consistent with Stark depopulation and/or antiferromagnetic exchange. Fitted Ising exchange for model 1' is antiferromagnetic for J12 and J21a and ferromagnetic for J11a. Ab initio results for Dy1 give a mixed ground state with substantial transverse g components.

synthesis.procedure: All reactions were carried out under aerobic conditions. A mixture of the Schiff-base H2L (0.2 mmol, 48.6 mg) and triethylamine (0.4 mmol, 0.06 mL) in acetonitrile (5 mL) was stirred for 10 min. Solid Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.3 mmol, 131.6 mg) was added and the mixture was stirred for a further 30 min. A DMF (5 mL) solution of hexafluoroacetylacetone (0.2 mmol, 0.03 mL) and triethylamine (0.2 mmol, 0.03 mL) was then added and stirring was continued for 1 h. The solution was filtered and the filtrate was left at room temperature for two days. Yellow block crystals formed by slow evaporation and were collected by filtration (58% yield based on Dy). H2L is 2-(2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzylideneamino)phenol, prepared separately by condensation of 2-aminophenol and o-vanillin in a 1:1 molar ratio in hot ethanol.

properties.summary: Complex 2 is a Dy4 SMM whose relaxation is enhanced relative to 1 by lowering the Dy1 coordination number from nine to eight. Under zero dc field, χ' and χ'' show maxima and the ln(τ) vs 1/T curve is fit by combined Raman and Orbach processes with Ueff/kB = 114 K. No hysteresis is observed between −30 and 30 kOe at 1.8 K. χMT decreases on cooling; the low-temperature behaviour is attributed to overall antiferromagnetic intramolecular exchange dominating ferromagnetic dipolar coupling. Best-fit Ising exchanges for model 2' are J12 = 0, J21a = −2 and J11a = −2.25 cm^-1. Ab initio calculations give a more axial Dy1 ground state than in 1.
